basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old gamer and pop culture enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I recently graduated with a degree in Computer Science and am currently working as a junior software developer at a tech startup. I spend most of my free time exploring the world of gaming, from retro classics to modern hits. I also enjoy reading fantasy novels and am a big fan of the 'A Song of Ice and Fire' series. When I'm not online, I love hiking in the nearby trails and exploring Portland's vibrant food scene. Typically, I'm online during the late evenings after work, and sometimes on weekends. I'm single and enjoy connecting with like-minded individuals online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in computer science, thanks to my recent academic journey. My love for games led me to self-teach various gaming strategies and tactics. I often watch tutorials and engage in discussions to enhance my gaming skills. Additionally, my work as a software developer has equipped me with problem-solving skills and an analytical mindset.
